add_expense:
def add_expense(state, amount, category) do
  store_expense(state, amount, category, nil)
end

def add_expense(state, amount, category, note) do
  if is_nil(note), do: raise("breaks expenses-shape")
  if not is_binary(note), do: raise("note must be a string")
  store_expense(state, amount, category, note)
end
by_category:
def by_category(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("expenses", [])
  |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn e, acc ->
    Map.update(acc, e["category"], e["amount"], fn cur -> cur + e["amount"] end)
  end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {category, amount} -> {category, round(amount * 100) / 100} end)
  |> Enum.sort()
  |> Map.new()
end
over_budget:
def over_budget(state) do
  budgets = Map.get(state, "budgets", %{})
  spent = by_category(state)

  budgets
  |> Enum.filter(fn {category, limit} -> Map.get(spent, category, 0) > limit end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {category, _limit} -> category end)
  |> Enum.sort()
end
to_cents:
defp to_cents(amount) when is_integer(amount), do: amount
defp to_cents(amount), do: round(amount * 100) / 100
top_category:
def top_category(state) do
  case by_category(state) |> Enum.sort_by(fn {category, amount} -> {-amount, category} end) do
    [{category, _amount} | _] -> category
    [] -> nil
  end
end
total:
def total(state) do
  amount =
    state
    |> Map.get("expenses", [])
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn e, sum -> sum + e["amount"] end)

  round(amount * 100) / 100
end
